import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=[str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent),str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)]
from repair_trial_support import ROOT, RepairTrial, config_for
from distill.eval import harness
from distill.eval.fixtures import Fixture
from distill.library.paths import atomic_write_json
from distill.pipeline.costs import CostTracker

trial=RepairTrial()
for tag in ('SITE','ANALYSIS','QA'):
    os.environ.pop(f'DISTILL_{tag}_LOCAL_THINK',None)
plan=json.loads((ROOT/'text-source-plan.json').read_text())
results=[]; packet=[]
harness.llm_call=trial.bounded_call
for case_id in ('faros-extraction','genuine-probability'):
    raw=plan['fixtures'][case_id]
    for key in ('expected_sections','golden_concepts','source_stems','risk_patterns'):
        raw[key]=tuple(raw[key])
    before=len(trial.receipt['attempts'])
    output=harness._run_analysis(Fixture(**raw),config_for('ministral-3:8b'),CostTracker())
    row={'case_id':case_id,'output':output,'attempt_indexes':list(range(before,len(trial.receipt['attempts']))),'max_tokens':4096,'comparison_limit':'route qualification, not matched-budget causal comparison with tiny model'}
    results.append(row)
    packet.append({'sample_id':'strong-'+case_id,'question':'Assess source faithfulness in every section, preserve correct metrics/denominators, causal/population limits and true probability. Do not excuse an overclaim because a caveat appears elsewhere.','supplied_source_evidence':raw['source_text'],'source_handles':[raw['url']],'candidate_answer':output,'completion_status':'completed','terminal_reasons':[trial.receipt['attempts'][i]['response']['finish_reason'] for i in row['attempt_indexes']]})
    atomic_write_json(ROOT/'strong-text-results.json',results)
    atomic_write_json(ROOT/'strong-text-blind-inputs.json',packet)
trial.save()
print('Stronger text outputs:',len(results))
